title: Instructor bookings (private store inputs/bookings.yaml)
description: What a calendar or travel tool exports for the staffing matching view (decision 0026): per booking, the instructor, a programme reference, the dates, the region and whether it means travel. Kept in the private store, read only by `teachermodel staffing-match` and the role surfaces, never an event. The reference names a programme, never a client or a person. @2 adds exported_at, which the freshness register reads (decision 0028); @1 files (contracts/v1/) are still read.

exported_at.description: When the calendar or travel tool was exported

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, optionally with a subdivision, as in the staffing check
